entities.summary: Warren Perley Knowles III was an American lawyer and politician who was the 37th governor of Wisconsin from 1965 to 1971. Prior to that, he was the 32nd and 34th lieutenant governor of Wisconsin, and represented St. Croix, Buffalo, Pepin, and Pierce Counties in the Wisconsin Senate for fourteen years.
